landing.heroBadge: One platform for the whole education system
landing.heroSubheading: ProctiraERP gives ministries, boards, schools, and families one secure place to register, track, assess, and report — without the spreadsheet sprawl.
landing.trustBar: Trusted by ministries, boards, and school networks across multiple countries.
landing.featuresSubheading: Modular by design, the platform scales from a single school up to a national EMIS — share data across boundaries while keeping tenants isolated.
landing.feature1Body: From registration through transfers, examinations, and graduation — one record per learner across institutions and boards.
landing.feature2Body: Roll up indicators from classroom to country with shared definitions, drill-down, and offline-friendly dashboards.
landing.feature3Body: Approvals, notifications, and audits for enrolment, transfers, scholarships, and disciplinary actions.
landing.feature4Body: Tenant isolation, RBAC, audit trails, and encryption that meet ministry security standards.
landing.feature5Body: Field staff capture attendance, assessments, and surveys offline — sync resolves conflicts without losing data.
landing.feature6Body: First-class APIs and a plugin marketplace so partners can extend ProctiraERP without forking the core.
landing.ctaHeading: Ready to see ProctiraERP in your context?
landing.ctaBody: Walk through a tenant configured for your country, language, and curriculum in 30 minutes.

about.heading: Open source education infrastructure for the public good
about.lead: ProctiraERP is built so every education authority — from a single district to a national ministry — can run a modern EMIS without vendor lock-in.
about.missionBody: Make modern education management accessible to every ministry, board, and school by shipping an open, multilingual, multi-tenant platform that ships every quarter.
about.visionBody: A world where every learner is visible to the system that serves them — and every educator has the data they need to act.
about.principle1Body: Code, schemas, and APIs are public so ministries are never locked into a single vendor.
about.principle2Body: One deployment can serve a federation of districts, boards, or countries with strict data isolation.
about.principle3Body: RTL, Indic scripts, multiple calendars, and locale-aware data formats are first-class concerns.
about.principle4Body: Offline capture, deferred sync, and progressive enhancement keep the platform usable on patchy networks.

features.heading: An EMIS that grows with you
features.lead: Twelve modules share one identity model, one workflow engine, and one data warehouse so every report is reconciled by construction.
features.category1Body: Schools, classes, infrastructure, academic periods, and area hierarchies in a single tree.
features.category2Body: Profiles, enrolments, transfers, attendance, and parent contacts — fully auditable.
features.category3Body: Profiles, assignments, payroll integration, appraisals, and professional development.
features.category4Body: Schemes, items, results, and certification across boards.
features.category5Body: Built-in dashboards, ad-hoc reports, and an open data warehouse for downstream BI.
features.category6Body: Configurable approval chains for transfers, scholarships, and policy exceptions.
features.highlight3: Brand and theme overrides per tenant
features.highlight6: Open APIs with versioning and rate limits

pricing.heading: Plans that scale with your jurisdiction
pricing.lead: ProctiraERP is open source. The core is free forever. Hosted plans add SLA-backed operations, premium support, and managed integrations.
pricing.footnote: All plans include access to the full source code and the plugin marketplace.

contact.heading: Talk to the ProctiraERP team
contact.lead: Tell us about your jurisdiction, your scale, and what you're trying to solve. We will route you to the right people within one business day.
contact.salesBody: Pricing, procurement, and pilots for ministries and boards.
contact.supportBody: Existing customers — bug reports, usage questions, and SLA escalations.
contact.communityBody: Open source contributors, forum, and partner inquiries.
contact.officesBody: Distributed team across the Americas, Europe, Africa, and Asia. We run programs in 20+ countries.
contact.ctaBody: Skip the email thread and book a 30-minute demo with a solutions engineer.

demo.heading: See ProctiraERP in your context
demo.lead: Walk through a tenant configured for your country, language, and curriculum with a solutions engineer. Demos run 30–45 minutes and we tailor every one.
demo.agendaItem1: A tenant pre-loaded with a sample country, district, and schools
demo.agendaItem2: Student registration, transfer, and tracking flows end-to-end
demo.agendaItem3: Multi-level analytics with drill-down from country to classroom
demo.agendaItem4: Offline capture on mobile with conflict-aware sync
demo.agendaItem5: Branding, language, and role-based access tailored to your jurisdiction
demo.audienceBody: Bring whoever is involved in the decision — IT leads, EMIS owners, M&E specialists, and procurement. We can adapt the demo on the fly.
demo.preparationItem1: Share a brief on your scale, languages, and current systems
demo.preparationItem2: List the indicators you report up the chain today
demo.preparationItem3: Bring two or three pain points you'd like solved
demo.ctaBody: Email demo@proctira.org with your preferred times and time zone, and we'll confirm within one business day.
